note: He clears the physical criteria comfortably — hikes, mountain bikes, climbs, races obstacle courses, and wants upper-body strength on top of an already active base rather than rescue. He misses everything else. He sells air conditioning rather than owning a business or practising medicine; his stated budget was $300-400 for six months and he confirmed $6,000 was not possible 'at the moment'; and his health is not the neglected area, since he is one of the most physically active prospects in the batch. Two of the three misses are the criteria the stated ICP leans on hardest. Judged against the criteria rather than the outcome, he should not have reached a closer at full price, and the setter call did not surface it.
